text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her direct message. Moss's notes contain two ticket numbers for Quarrendon Freight Lines:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`, 5 Oct 2025). Drivers at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting text messages telling them which dock door to use when they checked in at the gate. It was fixed on 4 Oct, and the customer's contact, Thea Ramaswell, confirmed it was working on 5 Oct. The note also says the Eau Claire check-in logs should be saved before the 14 Oct maintenance window.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). Gate barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags on the night shift. It was passed to second-level product support. This note has no date.

I read all six of Moss's notes, and they're public files. Moss's other two North notes mention the account but don't give a ticket number. His two notes for the Central team don't mention it, and their tickets belong to other customers. I also warned her about Quarendon Freightways, spelled with one "r": it's a different company and not our customer.

The workspace knowledge search showed two other ticket numbers for the account that aren't from Moss's notes. #4912 is on the account's profile page, and #8841 is in Dana's own meeting notes. I left both out of the reply because she only asked for Moss's notes, and I couldn't confirm the profile page is something she can see.

The message has no money terms, so it didn't need anyone's approval.
